6.

The respondent no. 2 also lodged a complaint before the CAW Cell, Nanakpura which culminated into registration of FIR bearing no. 0024/2021 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at CWC,
Nanakpura wherein the petitioners were implicated.
After completion of investigation, the charge- sheet has already been filed and the trial is stated to be pending before the concerned trial court.
The petitioners no. 2 and 3 are the parents of the petitioner no. 1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Sher Singh, CWC, Nanakpura.

7. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their pending disputes vide Memorandum of Understanding dated 26.07.2022 whereby they have agreed to dissolve their marriage by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13 (B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

Out of the settlement, the petitioner no. 1 has agreed to pay Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lac and Fifty Thousand Only) to the respondent no. 2 towards full and final satisfaction of her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of marriage between the petitioner no. 1

8.

The marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 has already dissolved by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B (2) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 in petition bearing HMA no. 360/2023 titled as Preeti and Harinder Tanwar vide judgment dated 06.07.2023 passed by the court of Sh. 12. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 09.12.2016 and due to matrimonial differences, they started to live separately w.e.f. 01.04.2019, without any cohabitation.

13. The present petition along with pending applications, stands disposed of.
